triggers.desc: Triggers let this custom Agent run automatically: each trigger creates a new session run (visible on "Chat" page). You can select multiple trigger conditions; the system automatically appends "why this trigger was fired + related task/finding/goal" to your base message.

strategy.label: Post-trigger handling strategy (determines how triggers are queued/merged for execution)

triggers.desc_parallel: Parallel: each trigger immediately opens a separate session for concurrent execution, no merge; triggers exceeding max concurrency queue for a slot.
triggers.desc_by_task: Serial · Merge by task: same agent runs one at a time; events for the same task in queue merge into one session.
triggers.desc_all: Serial · Merge all: same agent runs one at a time; when dequeuing, all queued triggers merge into one session.
triggers.desc_none: Serial · No merge: same agent runs one at a time; each trigger gets its own session.

create.fill_description_goal: Please fill in description and goal
create.max_source_tasks: At most {{max}} source tasks can be associated
create.worker_count_invalid: Worker count must be an integer from 0 to {{max}}
create.create_description: Fill in the test target and goal; advanced parameters can be expanded as needed.
create.name_placeholder: Give the task a recognizable name, e.g. Acme official website penetration test
create.remark_placeholder: Additional notes, environment info, etc. for identifying in the task list
create.category_description: Optional, single category; used for task list filtering and archiving, does not affect Agent execution.
create.schedule_checkbox: Attach a schedule at creation to start and pause by time window
create.start_immediately: Start immediately after creation, otherwise wait for the first schedule window
create.description_placeholder: Test target and background, e.g. testing the example.com site
create.uploaded_files: {{count}} files uploaded, absolute paths appended to end of description (editable)
create.upload_hint: Multiple selection allowed; after uploading, absolute file paths are appended to the description for worker Read/Bash access
create.goal_placeholder: What to achieve, e.g. gain backend admin privileges, obtain server access
create.share_global_assets_description: Disabled by default, only uses this task's and explicitly associated tasks' assets. Enabling allows querying the global asset library; testing must still comply with authorization scope.
create.source_tasks_description: At most {{max}} tasks. Real-time read-only inheritance of selected tasks' persistent blackboard, asset scope, and related traffic; new task writes to an independent blackboard.
create.company_assets_description: When creating the task, the selected enterprises' existing assets are added to 'Test assets', and domains, IPs, CIDRs, ICP and enterprise keywords are provided to the Agent as scope context; does not automatically generate intents or force changes to execution goals.
create.intercept_rules_description: Effective only for this task, not written to global rules. Judgment order: match by 'intercept' rules (including global) first, hit means testing is prohibited; if not hit and this task has 'allow' rules, must hit an allow rule to proceed, otherwise testing is not allowed either; if no allow rules are configured, the whitelist is not enabled.
create.llm_profiles_description: Failover in list order; first item is current configuration, switch to next only when quota is clearly insufficient.
create.timeout_description: Triggers graceful shutdown at the time (each agent writes back + planner final determination), task enters timeout terminal state.
create.heartbeat_description: After this duration since last planning round / task start with no trigger, automatically triggers a planning round (fallback for stuck + wake up to supervise running workers). Minimum 10 minutes.
create.worker_count_description: Separately set the number of concurrent worker Agents for this task; leave empty or 0 = use global default (work concurrency in system settings, default 3). Maximum 50.
create.seed_first_intent_description: When enabled, 'description+goal' is delivered as an intent at creation; worker skips the first planning round and runs directly, then planner takes over for determination/supplement after completion. Recommended for CTF and similar scenarios that can be solved in one go; disabled follows standard plan-then-execute.
create.coverage_description: Enabled by default: calculate and display test coverage, situation map shows test progress, automatically accumulates test scope. Disabled: coverage is no longer calculated/displayed, situation map only shows assets without progress, agents no longer get scope tools. Disabling does not affect 'Associated enterprise asset scope'.
